commands.summary: 17/17 operator tests passed: signed Conv1d enclosure, attribute rejection, BatchNorm1d eval mode & negative/zero gamma, ReLU/MaxPool1d/Flatten, Linear layers & complete MLP head, ExactRationalOracle verification, cancellation stress, and fail-closed rejections
Generated operator_capabilities.json and operator_proof_review.md across all 15 SmallCNN1D layers

requirement_evidence.evidence: enclose_conv1d implements interval bounds for signed padded Conv1d using Higham reduction error bound gamma_{n+1}*(|W||X|+|b|) + subnormal padding. Exact zero-padding is treated as [0.0, 0.0]. Rejects stride!=1, dilation!=1, groups!=1, and invalid padding with UnsupportedNumericalError. Verified by test_c01_conv1d_point_enclosure_matches_pytorch, test_c01_conv1d_interval_soundness_against_perturbed_samples, and test_c01_conv1d_rejects_unsupported_attributes.

enclose_batchnorm1d handles frozen eval-mode BatchNorm1d with running_mean, running_var, gamma, beta, eps=1e-5. Correctly accounts for affine parameter folding alpha = gamma / sqrt(var + eps), beta_eff = beta - mu*alpha, and flips bounds when alpha < 0 or collapses when alpha = 0. Encloses floating-point folding and evaluation order via gamma_4 bound. Verified by test_c02_batchnorm1d_point_enclosure_matches_pytorch, test_c02_batchnorm1d_negative_and_zero_gamma, and test_c02_batchnorm1d_near_zero_variance.

enclose_relu implements exact non-expansive coordinatewise map [max(0, lo), max(0, hi)]. enclose_maxpool1d implements exact pairwise max on stride=2 pooling, correctly handling pool ties. enclose_flatten preserves exact channel-major indexing. All verified by test_c03_relu_enclosure, test_c03_maxpool1d_enclosure_and_ties, and test_c03_flatten_channel_major_order.

enclose_linear implements sound matrix-vector product with Higham error bound for validated lengths n in {128, 2048}. enclose_mlp_head evaluates complete Flatten(2048) -> Linear(128) -> ReLU -> Linear(12) head. Verified by test_c04_linear_layers_point_enclosure_matches_pytorch and test_c04_complete_mlp_head_enclosure.

Tiny exhaustive rational oracle ExactRationalOracle verifies Conv interval enclosure on rational inputs. High dynamic range cancellation stress tested without underflow failure. Verified by test_c05_rational_oracle_verification_on_tiny_conv and test_c05_cancellation_stress.

Training-mode BatchNorm1d, non-finite inputs, and unsupported attributes fail closed with UnsupportedNumericalError / NonFiniteIntervalError. Verified by test_c06_rejects_training_mode_batchnorm and test_c06_rejects_non_finite_inputs.

audit_smallcnn1d_operators audits all 15 SmallCNN1D sequential layers, confirming all are real_valid=True and executable_bridge_status='VALIDATED_FLOAT32_ENCLOSURE' under locked profile linux-x86_64-py311-numpy246-torch2141cpu-avx512. Documented in operator_capabilities.json and operator_proof_review.md, verified by test_c07_end_to_end_smallcnn1d_enclosure and test_c07_operator_capabilities_audit.

scientific_dispositions: Confirms H05/H07/H08: Every single operator in SmallCNN1D(num_classes=12) admits a mathematically sound, executable float32 interval enclosure using Higham backward error bounds and outward directed rounding.
Proves H22: Operator-level interval enclosures preserve exact mathematical bounds on the locked CPU profile without relying on empirical approximations.
limitations: Enclosures are validated specifically for SmallCNN1D operator configurations (Conv stride=1, dilation=1, groups=1; MaxPool kernel=2, stride=2, padding=0; eval-mode BatchNorm).
Accumulation bounds assume worst-case summation order (gamma_N); backend-specific pairwise or FMA vectorization may achieve tighter bounds but would require backend-locked proofs.
